Flow.description: Use this flow to handle Application Resubmission For Lease and Loan App. SAL-5369

formulas.name: formulaFieldValuesatResubmission
formulas.expression:
"Decision Status: " & TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Decision_Status__c}) & BR() & "Equipment Cost: $" &
IF( {!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF( {!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} / 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} )), 3) & "." & IF( MOD({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} , 1) * 100 < 10, "0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} , 1), 2) * 100), TEXT(MIN(ROUND(MOD({!Get_Opportunity.Equipment_Cost__c} , 1), 2) * 100, 99)) )&
BR() & "Terms: " & TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Terms__c})

formulas.name: formulaResubmissionType
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Application_Status__c})="Rejected", "Appeal Decision", IF(OR(CONTAINS(TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Application_Status__c}),"More Info"),TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Application_Status__c})="Returned to Submitter"), IF(CONTAINS(TEXT({!Get_Opportunity.Opportunity_Status__c}),"Fraud More Info Requested"), "Fraud Resubmission", "More Info"), ""))

Flow.label: Resubmit to Credit Action

fields.name: Error_occurred
fields.fieldText: This Resubmission to Credit Details Record was not created due : {!ErrorMassage}

fields.name: Success_Massage
fields.fieldText: Opportunity resubmitted to credit.
